gloss: steadily, rapidly, by leaps and bounds

definitions.gloss: steadily, rapidly, by leaps and bounds
definitions.explanation: Describes continuous, noticeable progress or increase. Emphasizes steady and strong momentum.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がぐんぐん{成長|せいちょう}している。
{気温|きおん}がぐんぐん{上|あ}がっている。
{売|う}り{上|あ}げがぐんぐん{伸|の}びた。
examples.english: Sales grew by leaps and bounds.

examples.japanese: ぐんぐん{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}られて{前|まえ}に{進|すす}んだ。

notes:
ぐんぐん is an onomatopoeic adverb that expresses steady, powerful progress or increase. It conveys a sense of unstoppable momentum.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ぐんぐん{成長|せいちょう}する (grow rapidly)
・ぐんぐん{伸|の}びる (extend/grow steadily)
・ぐんぐん{上|あ}がる/{下|さ}がる (rise/fall steadily)
・ぐんぐん{進|すす}む (advance steadily)

NUANCE: Unlike {徐々|じょじょ}に (gradually), which emphasizes slowness, ぐんぐん emphasizes strength and noticeable speed of change.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・どんどん: One after another, rapidly (emphasizes succession)
・ぐんぐん: Steadily, powerfully (emphasizes continuous momentum)
・めきめき: Rapidly improving (often for skills)
